# coderforge_secret (Data Source)

Look up a secret's metadata by id or by name, usually to wire its id into a container service's `env_secret_rid`.

The material is deliberately not returned: a data source that read it would copy every secret value into Terraform state on every plan. Only the key names are reported.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Resource id, for example `secret:0004`. Specify this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Secret name. Specify this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `keys` (List of String) Key names stored in the vault. The values are not returned.
- `owner_rid` (String)
- `type` (String) `KV` or `PKI`.
- `updated_at` (String)
